map.选择今日摄入的高钠食物，估算钠与食盐总量，帮助控盐。: Select the high-sodium foods you ate today to estimate total sodium and salt intake and help control your salt.
map.食盐摄入量 = Σ 各食物摄入量(g) × 钠含量(mg/100g) ÷ 100: Salt intake = Σ intake(g) × sodium content(mg/100g) ÷ 100 ÷ 393.4; 1 g of salt contains about 393 mg of sodium, and the conversion is salt(g) ≈ sodium(mg) ÷ 400; the Chinese dietary guidelines recommend no more than 5 g of salt per day (about 2000 mg of sodium) and 3 to 5 g for people with high blood pressure; pickled products and processed meat can reach 800 to 2000 mg of sodium per 100 g.
map.世界卫生组织建议：成人每日食盐摄入不超过 5g（约 2000mg 钠），高血压患: World Health Organization recommendation: adults should not exceed 5 g of salt per day (about 2000 mg of sodium), and people with high blood pressure should keep it as close to 3 g as possible.
map.勾选常吃食物估全天钠/盐摄入，对比 <5g 盐上限: Tick the foods you often eat to estimate daily sodium and salt intake, then compare against the 5 g salt ceiling
map.高钠人群（高血压）找隐藏盐来源（酱料/加工肉）: For high-sodium groups (high blood pressure), find hidden salt sources such as sauces and processed meat
map.用钠换算盐：盐(g) ≈ 钠(mg)/0.393/1000: Convert sodium to salt: salt(g) ≈ sodium(mg)/0.393/1000
map.全天钠 2300mg → 盐 ≈ 2300÷0.393÷1000 ≈ 5.85g: 2300 mg of sodium for the whole day → salt ≈ 2300÷0.393÷1000 ≈ 5.85 g, over the 5 g ceiling; dropping one spoon of soy sauce (about 1000 mg of sodium) saves roughly 2.5 g of salt.
map.午餐肉 100g 钠 ≈ 1000mg、榨菜 100g ≈ 4250mg、挂面: Luncheon meat 100 g sodium ≈ 1000 mg, pickled mustard tuber 100 g ≈ 4250 mg, dried noodles 100 g ≈ 900 mg; processed foods that do not taste salty can have off-the-charts sodium.
map.盐和钠怎么换？: How do salt and sodium convert?
map.食盐 NaCl 含钠约 39.3%，盐(g) = 钠(mg)/393；5g 盐: Table salt NaCl is about 39.3% sodium, so salt(g) = sodium(mg)/393; 5 g of salt ≈ 1965 mg of sodium, and the guidelines recommend less than 5 g of salt per day.
map.低钠盐能随便吃吗？: Can low-sodium salt be used freely?
map.低钠盐用钾代钠，肾功不全/服保钾药者高钾有风险，仍应控总盐量。: Low-sodium salt replaces sodium with potassium, which is risky for people with impaired kidney function or those taking potassium-sparing drugs, so total salt intake still needs control.
